_comment: Instruction bank per task. 'train' phrasings are rotated through during data collection; 'heldout' phrasings are NEVER recorded and are used only at evaluation to measure the paraphrase generalization gap. Task ids match the Extreme-Version curriculum table in CLAUDE.md.

train: Put the red block in the green bowl.
Place the red block into the green bowl.
Drop the red block in the green bowl.
Move the red block into the green bowl.
heldout: Set the red cube down inside the green dish.
The red block goes in the green bowl.
Into the green bowl, put the red block.

train: Drop the orange ball into the blue cup.
Put the orange ball in the blue cup.
Place the orange ball into the blue cup.
heldout: The orange ball belongs in the blue cup.
Deposit the orange ball inside the blue cup.

train: Move the blue block to the center of the table.
Put the blue block in the middle of the table.
Bring the blue block to the center.
heldout: Slide the blue block into the middle.
Center the blue block on the mat.

train: Move the red block to the left of the blue block.
Put the red block to the left of the blue block.
Place the red block left of the blue block.
heldout: The red block should sit on the left side of the blue block.
Position the red block just left of the blue one.

train: Stack the green block on the red block.
Put the green block on top of the red block.
Place the green block onto the red block.
heldout: Set the green block on the red block.
Balance the green block atop the red block.

train: Pick up the red block, not the red ball.
Grab the red block, not the ball.
Take the red block and ignore the red ball.
heldout: Lift the red block; leave the red ball.
It's the red block you want, not the red ball.
